name: ibmi-member-workspace
description: Work with IBM i source members locally, compare changes, and synchronize them safely. Works with Code for IBM i.
author: Vinhry

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Checked-out members are uploaded to the IBM i, and Local Change History runs Git in the checkout folder.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Let Bob's agent research your IBM i programs: what a program uses, what uses it, file layouts and source. The tools only read the IBM i.
[Connect Bob to IBM i Research Tools](command:ibmi-member-workspace.bob.connectResearchTools)

The IBM i research tools for Bob are turned off in your user settings.
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22ibmi-member-workspace.bob.researchTools%22%5D)

Let Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot research your IBM i programs: what a program uses, what uses it, file layouts and source. The tools only read the IBM i.
[Connect an AI Agent](command:ibmi-member-workspace.agents.connect)

The IBM i research tools for AI agents are turned off in your user settings.
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22ibmi-member-workspace.agents.researchTools%22%5D)

Choose where checked-out member files will be stored for this workspace.
[Choose Checkout Folder](command:ibmi-member-workspace.configureCheckoutFolder)

No members are checked out yet.
Right-click a source member (or a source file) in the Code for IBM i Object Browser and choose Check Out.

Search source members by name, the source of a program, or member text, then check them out through your change-management system, bring them as read-only reference copies, or check them out for change.
[Find Member…](command:ibmi-member-workspace.findMember)

ibmi-member-workspace.warnOnRedownload.description: Show warning when checking out a member that is already checked out.

ibmi-member-workspace.autoOpenOnCheckout.description: Automatically open the file in the editor after checkout.

ibmi-member-workspace.allowCheckoutFromP.description: Allow checking out source members from protected (read-only) filters. Off by default to prevent accidental edits to protected sources.

enumDescriptions: Upload only with the Upload to IBM i command.
Ask before uploading a checked-out member each time you save it.
Upload a checked-out member whenever you save it, without asking.
ibmi-member-workspace.autoUploadOnSave.markdownDescription: Upload a checked-out member to the IBM i when you save it in the editor. Only saves with local changes upload, and a member changed on the IBM i since checkout always asks before it is overwritten. Files changed by other tools are never uploaded automatically. Only user settings are read, so a workspace can't turn it on.

ibmi-member-workspace.backgroundRefresh..markdownDescription: Refresh the remote status of your checked-out members when Code for IBM i connects. Only members changed on the IBM i since they were last compared are downloaded. Only user settings are read, so a workspace can't turn it on.

Refresh the remote status of your checked-out members every this many minutes while connected (at least 5). `0` turns it off. Only members changed on the IBM i since they were last compared are downloaded. Only user settings are read, so a workspace can't turn it on.

ibmi-member-workspace.gitIntegration.description: Keep local checkpoints organized by work item in one Git repository per IBM i system directory. Does not upload or push changes.

ibmi-member-workspace.bob.researchTools.markdownDescription: **IBM Bob only.** Offer IBM i research tools to Bob's agent: what a program uses, what uses it, file layouts and source, through a local MCP server that only this computer can reach. Members Bob looks at are brought as read-only reference copies. Run **Connect Bob to IBM i Research Tools** to add the server to a folder's `.bob/mcp.json`. Has no effect in VS Code. Only user settings are read, so a workspace can't turn it on.

ibmi-member-workspace.bob.whereUsedMaxLi.markdownDescription: **IBM Bob only.** How many search libraries Bob's `find_where_used` tool reads when Bob doesn't name any, from 1 to 25. Each library runs `DSPPGMREF` over every program in it, one library after another, so more libraries take longer. Bob stops waiting for a tool after its MCP network timeout (1 minute by default): raise that in Bob's MCP settings when you use a large value.

ibmi-member-workspace.agents.researchToo.markdownDescription: **VS Code and IBM Bob** (GitHub Copilot in VS Code only). Let Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot use IBM i research tools: what a program uses, what uses it, file layouts and source, through a local MCP server that only this computer can reach. Nothing runs until you connect an agent with **Connect an AI Agent to IBM i Research Tools**. Members an agent looks at are brought as read-only reference copies. Only user settings are read, so a workspace can't turn it on.

ibmi-member-workspace.agents.whereUsedMa.markdownDescription: **Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot.** How many search libraries the `find_where_used` research tool reads when the agent doesn't name any, from 1 to 25. Each library runs `DSPPGMREF` over every program in it, one library after another, so more libraries take longer.

ibmi-member-workspace.researchTools.allo.markdownDescription: Let the `sample_file_data` research tool return the first rows of a file or table (at most 100) to IBM Bob's agent, Claude Code, Codex or GitHub Copilot. Rows can hold business data, so this is off until you turn it on. The other research tools return only metadata and source. User settings only.

ibmi-member-workspace.dependencies.sugge.description: After checking out a single member, offer to review the copybooks, called programs, referenced files, and SQL tables it uses. Nothing is downloaded until you choose.

ibmi-member-workspace.dependencies.trans.markdownDescription: How many levels **Find All Dependencies** looks through before asking whether to keep going: 1 is what the member uses, 2 adds what those members use, and so on. Members on the last level are listed but not looked into.

How many members **Find All Dependencies** lists before asking whether to keep going. Each member's source is read from the IBM i, and its compiled program is checked with `DSPPGMREF`, so a larger number takes longer.

ibmi-member-workspace.changeManagement.c.markdownDescription: CL command that checks a member out in your change-management system (for example Rocket LMI), run on the IBM i for each member when you choose **Check Out Through Change Management…** (Find Member, the Object Browser, Checked Out Members) or **I Need to Change Some…** (Find Dependencies). Placeholders: `&OPENLIB`, `&OPENSPF`, `&OPENMBR` and `&EXT` (the member's library, source file, member and source type), `&DEVLIB` (the development library, asked each time), `&PROJECT` (the change-management project or task, asked each time the command uses it), `&RELEASE` (the release, pre-filled from `changeManagement.release`) and `&USER` (the user profile Code for IBM i is connected with). The commands are shown before they run. Empty: the steps are explained instead. User settings only. Line breaks are joined with spaces, so a long command can be split over lines.

CL command that checks a member in to your change-management system (for example Rocket LMI), run on the IBM i for each member when you choose **Check In Through Change Management…** (Checked Out Members) or **Check In…** after an upload. Placeholders: `&DEVLIB` (the library the member is checked out in), `&OPENSPF`, `&OPENMBR` and `&EXT` (its source file, member and source type), `&OPENLIB` (the library it was checked out from, known for members checked out with **Check Out Through Change Management…**, otherwise asked), `&PROJECT` (the project, suggested from the checkout), `&RELEASE` (the release, suggested from the checkout or `changeManagement.release`) and `&USER` (the user profile Code for IBM i is connected with). The commands are shown before they run. Members with changes not yet uploaded, and reference copies, are never checked in. Empty: Check In… isn't offered. User settings only. Line breaks are joined with spaces.

ibmi-member-workspace.changeManagement.r.markdownDescription: The release `&RELEASE` stands for in the change-management checkout command, for example `MYGROUP/MYAPP/BASE` (Rocket LMI's group/application/release). It's filled in at each checkout, where you can change it for that checkout and make the new one the default. User settings only.

enumDescriptions: Search Libraries when `dependencies.searchLibraries` lists some, otherwise Library List.
The connection's current library and library list, as shown in Code for IBM i.
Only the libraries in `dependencies.searchLibraries`, in order.
Every library except IBM's (Q… and #… libraries, apart from QGPL and QUSR…), library list first. This reads the whole system catalog, so it can take a while on a large system.
ibmi-member-workspace.dependencies.searc.markdownDescription: Where **Find Dependencies** looks for the source of dependencies. **Library List** and **Search Libraries** never leave those libraries: a dependency that names another library (for example, where DSPPGMREF says a program was compiled from) is looked for by name inside them instead. To search somewhere else once, use the library button in the dependency list's title bar.

Libraries to search, in order, when `dependencies.searchScope` is **Search Libraries** or **Automatic**, for the source members and compiled programs of dependencies found by **Find Dependencies**, for example your production object and source libraries (`PRODOBJ`, `PRODSRC`). When empty, the connection's current library and library list are searched.

enumDescriptions: Scan the member's local source text.
Run DSPPGMREF on the compiled program in the search libraries.
Run the queries in dependencies.crossReferences (for example, against Abstract).

ibmi-member-workspace.dependencies.sourc.markdownDescription: Where **Find Dependencies** looks. Each source is also checked on the connected IBM i and left out when it isn't available there (for example, no compiled program, or a cross-reference tool that isn't installed).

name.description: Shown in Find Dependencies, for example "Abstract".

query.description: A SELECT statement. Placeholders {library}, {sourceFile}, {member} and {object} are passed as parameters. Return KIND (copybook, program, file, or an object type such as *FILE or *PGM) and MEMBER or OBJECT; optionally LIBRARY and SOURCE_FILE (the source member's location), LINE and TEXT.

systems.description: Host names this query applies to. Empty means every system.

requiresLibrary.description: Only use this query on systems where this library exists, for example the library holding the tool's cross-reference files.

ibmi-member-workspace.dependencies.cross.markdownDescription: Cross-reference tools to ask in **Find Dependencies**, such as Abstract, Pathfinder or MDXREF. Each entry is a SQL `SELECT` against the tool's files; see **Dependencies** in the README for the columns and an example. Only user settings are read, so a workspace can't add queries.
